title: hieracium solidagineum subsp. leptoclinium
intro: Hieracium solidagineum subsp. leptoclinium, commonly known as a subspecies of hawkweed, is a flowering plant of the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium solidagineum subsp. leptoclinium include promoting digestion, reducing fever, and acting as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
